design: Comfrey — pooled LightGBM/ridge learner of per-asset TACTIC PnL (K=8 shadow-run deterministic rules as the supervised target generator, y_{i,k,t} = [p_{i,k,t}·e_{i,t+1} − c|Δp|]/σ̂_YZ), collapsed to an asset-level forecast f_{i,t} = Σ_k μ̂_k p_k / Σ_k |p_k|, driven through a β-hedged Gârleanu–Pedersen partial-adjustment controller (θ ∈ {0.25, 0.5}, no-trade band δ frozen on train, turnover ≤ 0.06/day), graded PIT 2022-01→2026-06 at 21 bp on `trader/` with a three-stage kill (Stage-0 tactic hull, K1/K1'/K1'' IC gates, K2 book gate).

strongest_objection: The mechanism is TASK_915 restated, which the operator's request excluded. The design puts the tactic's own position p_{i,k,t} into the feature vector x (F-tactic-state) and every p_k is a deterministic causal function of the same OHLC panel. Then E[y_k | x] = p_k · E[e_{i,t+1} | x] / σ̂ exactly, and the collapse f = Σ_k μ̂_k p_k / Σ_k |p_k| = E[e | x]/σ̂ for every sign tactic (p_k² = 1) — literally TASK_915's market-residual, vol-standardised conditional-mean target (memo §4.2, `lore/fable_direction_memo_2026-09-03.md:254-261`; `tasks/TASK_915_IC_CEILING_AND_GP_BOOK.md:12-16`). The eight targets are invertible transforms of e given x, so the "2.8M target rows" carry the information of ~350k asset-days × one target — the same sample TASK_915 fits; the Huber loss on p·e/σ̂ with |p| = 1 is the same loss as on e/σ̂. The design's own open doubt concedes it ("a GBM on F1+F2 there can in principle learn s(x_trend)·g(x_regime) from the raw target; this design's incremental value is representational"). The only genuine representational gain is for the RIDGE arm (sign×regime becomes a main effect), which equals adding F1-sign × F2/F3 interaction features to TASK_915's ridge — a feature-list line, not a learning mechanism. The controller is TASK_915's G-C GP book with the memo's own θ form (`memo:287-295`). The profit-source claim that this is "a different quantity from TASK_915's unconditional E[e|x]: nonzero in dispersion while zero in mean" is false: TASK_915's statistic is the per-date CROSS-SECTIONAL Spearman IC, which is itself a dispersion measure and is zero-mean-invariant. Nothing here is information a closed-form estimator (or 915's GBM) cannot already use.
arithmetic_check: Verified as stated: SR_d = √N_eff·(m − cτ/σ̄) follows from Var((σ̄/N)Σz_i) = σ̄²/N_eff; 0.97/√365 = 0.0508, 0.56/√365 = 0.0293; cτ/σ̄ = 0.0081/0.00315/0.0016 at τ = 0.155/0.06/0.03; required m = 0.0192/0.0145/0.0242/0.0124 for the four cases; E[sign(S)·e] = ρ√(2/π) = 0.798ρ; corr(S_30, e) ≈ √30·ρ for a flat lag profile; VR(30) − 1 = 2Σ(1 − j/30)ρ_j = 29ρ → 0.10–0.16; 819 calibration: cost 0.18 Sharpe = 0.0094 SR_d ⇒ N_eff ≈ 1.39, m ≈ 0.033 (gross 0.74/19.1/1.18), VR(30) ≈ 1.2; annualised cost drag 0.19/0.49; break-even hold 0.0042/0.0008 = 5.25 d; E[max Z_N] = 1.267/1.629/1.948 for N = 6/12/24 → SR0 = 0.80/1.03/1.23 on 2.5 yr and 0.60/0.77/0.92 on 4.5 yr; MinBTL 1.7/2.8 yr; 18 refits × 2 × 3 = 108 fits; ~220 mean live names × 1640 days ≈ 360k asset-days. Errors and omissions: (1) "trend/reversal arms share one g(x) (mirror targets), halving the effective noise" is false — an exact mirror is a duplicated row with a negated target and adds zero information; the library has no exact mirrors anyway (k4 = 1-day reversal, not −trend-30), so the "one g(x)" claim conflates lag-1, lag-5, lag-10/30/90 autocorrelations. (2) Multiplicity is understated: K1 selects among 18 IC cells on 2024-01→2026-06 and K2 grades the winner's Sharpe on the same window, then over 3 controller settings × 2 estimators × 3 seeds; the selection path is N ≈ 18–54, and by the design's own Bailey formula E[max Z_18] ≈ 1.85, E[max Z_54] ≈ 2.31 ⇒ SR0 = 1.17/1.46 on 2.5 yr and 0.87/1.09 on 4.5 yr — the +0.97 bar is inside the null on the 2.5-yr window at the design's own K1 cell count, contradicting the "N ≤ 6" accounting. (3) Entry rule vs its own IC: a calibrated IC-0.02 forecast has SD(f) ≈ 0.02 σ-units; the threshold 2cθ/σ̂ is 0.026 at θ = 0.25 (1.3 SD, ~19% of asset-days enter) and 0.0525 at θ = 0.5 (2.6 SD, ~1%, ≈2–3 names/day), so the θ = 0.5 setting cannot reach N_eff 10–20 and the θ = 0.25 setting holds 4 d against a 5.3 d break-even; the design's own arithmetic says the typical position does not pay its round trip. (4) The BTC β-hedge leg is not placed inside or outside the Σ|w| ≤ 1 cap; a ~50%-short residual book plus hedge either breaches no-leverage or scales the residual gross down and the required m up by 1/(1 − h). (5) "BEAR22 is OUT of sample" is false for ~7 of 59 weeks: BEAR22 = 2021-11-10→2022-12-31 (`trader/config.py:66-74`) while the first training window ends 2021-12-31.
profit_source_check: Stated source (forecast) is honestly labelled and is the only one claimed — no risk-premium or rebalancing-premium smuggling; constant-mix is correctly a control arm (measured negative, `POWERED_RESULT.md` B&H row via `backtest.py:225-227`). But it is a forecast of the FIRST MOMENT E[e_{i,t+1} | x]/σ̂ — identical to TASK_915's estimand once p_k ∈ x (see strongest objection). The "conditional lag-L autocorrelation regime ≈ 0.80ρ_L(x)" framing is a relabelling of the same quantity (ρ_L(x) = corr(S_L, e | x) with S_L in x). Is it already measured dead? Not in the form that settles it (915 is PROPOSED, queue row 6, unrun), so the design is not refuted on the signal — but the record already bounds its dominant arm: the trend-30 sign target's unconditional PIT PnL is ≈0 on 2024–26 (898: 2024 +0.041, 2025 +0.663, 2026H1 −1.659, no CI excluding 0) and its pooled OOS IC on 20 majors 2024-07→2025-08 reads −0.0213 at H=1 and +0.0009 at H=5 (`CAPACITY_RESULT.md` H=1/H=5 tables, TSMOM sign30d row), so m_k1 ≈ IC ≈ 0 to −0.02 against a required 0.015–0.024; everything rests on the DISPERSION of E[e|x] across (asset, day), which is exactly what 915's per-date cross-sectional IC measures. The design is therefore a forecast in disguise of TASK_915's quantity, not of a quantity measured dead.

surviving_mechanism: No standalone learning mechanism survives; three amendments to already-proposed rows do. (a) TASK_915 SPEC: add F1-sign × F2/F3 interaction features to the ridge arm (the one real representational content of the tactic-PnL transform), add the per-asset trailing-60/90-day tactic-PnL "strategy momentum" feature and report it as a named closed-form baseline B0 next to every G-A cell (the K1' comparison — the only novel gate here), and add the IC-autocorrelation persistence statistic τ_IC with the 5-day break-even as an annotation (already the loops panel's surviving item). (b) Tactics panel row 1 (Stage-0 hull) as written, with the oracle fixed at book level, extended by the four unmeasured daily arms (1 d residual reversal, 5 d xs reversal, 21 d xs momentum on residuals, vol-targeted trend) scored via `experiments/898_trend_decay/decay_harness.py::score_window` on 2024-01→2026-06 — minutes of CPU, and the first direct measurement of whether any daily deterministic book is positive after 2024. (c) If 915 G-A passes, the θ/δ partial-adjustment controller with train-frozen band and the pre-registered entry/exit-vs-re-trim decomposition against a frozen-hold counterfactual is a sensible concrete form of G-C; it is not a mechanism, it is the memo's G-C spelled out.
kill_experiment_critique: Runnability on `trader/`: the PIT OHLCV panel needs a new builder (both `build_daily_panel_from_db`, `trader/data.py:190-227`, and `read_ohlcv_daily`, `:266-316`, and the 819 `powered.py:189-231` builder keep close only) — the design says so; `ohlcv_daily` does carry O/H/L/V/trade_count for both agg1m and kraken_rest sources (`data.py:233-246`, `tools/fetch_daily_kraken.py:53-56, 271-272`), so data exist. But the named scoring instrument is wrong: `cell_metrics` cannot score 2024-01→2026-06, by-year, 2026H1 or 2022-01→2026-06, and `window_metrics` cannot accept external positions; the correct existing instrument is 898's `score_window`. Controls: the strategy-momentum B0 baseline and pooled-unconditional B1 are the right closed-form controls and are the one genuinely new element; the two dependence-preserving placebos are correct and already scheduled for 915. Multiplicity: the "N ≤ 6, SR0(6) = 0.80" accounting ignores that K2's cell is selected via 18 IC cells on the same 2.5-yr window — SR0(18) = 1.17 there, above the bar; grade only on the 4.5-yr span or count the path. Stage-0 oracle is unspecified and, per-asset, vacuous. BEAR22 is 12% in-sample. The scorer cannot see the promised drift-re-trim charge or simple-return read without modification, and the BTC hedge leg's place under Σ|w| ≤ 1 is undefined, so the K2 book is under-specified for the scorer. The entry threshold at θ = 0.5 (2.6 SD of a calibrated IC-0.02 forecast) yields a 2–3-name book, contradicting the N_eff 10–20 the arithmetic needs; at θ = 0.25 the holding period (4 d) is below the design's own break-even (5.3 d). Cost accounting is fine (one CPU-day, no GPU, 14-day kill). Net: as a row it is TASK_915 (queue row 6, precondition 899 ingest) run twice with a different name; the non-duplicated content is three SPEC lines for 915 and four extra arms for the tactics hull.
odds_after_refutation: As a standalone mechanism: refuted as new — its measurement is TASK_915's measurement, so its odds ARE 915's odds minus the extra selection: P(net@21 ≥ +0.97 PIT, CI lo > 0, 3 seeds, bear-positive, holds positions | run as designed) ≈ 4–6% (design claimed 5–7%; the memo gives 915 ≈ 10–15% for +0.97, but that was for the ceiling instrument's best cell before the controller and before the 2.5-yr multiplicity; on this design's own arithmetic the 0.97 bar sits inside SR0(18) on the 2024–26 window). P(≥ +0.56 MARGINAL) ≈ 8–10%. P(the design adds a bit of information TASK_915 would not produce on its own) ≈ 10–15%, entirely from the B0 comparison and the ridge interaction arm — worth SPEC lines in 915 and four arms in the tactics hull, not a CPU-day and a queue row. P(K1'' persistence ≥ 5 d | K1 passes) is the design's most likely non-null outcome (pass K1, fail K1'') and yields no book — agreed, and that statistic is already on 915's list.
